name: Multi-camera podcasts
description: Use when editing a podcast or interview shot on several cameras: sync by sound, the speaker's camera while one talks, the wide when people talk over each other, a look at the listener, and the best microphone throughout.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
